description: The policy card loses its scope: 'the orchestrator also retries failed reservations' replaces 'reservations are never retried'. The old pattern only knew 'reservations are retried'.

mutations.find: Applies only to supplier calls. Reservations are never retried: a failed reservation goes back to the caller as an error.
mutations.replace: Applies to supplier calls; the orchestrator also retries failed reservations.
